source_notice: References are page identifiers and original synthesized summaries, no verbatim protected manual pages

rules.rule_summary: LSK moves scratchpad data to target field where appropriate
rules.engine_behavior: Handle LSK field write / validated input / pending transaction

rules.rule_summary: LSK retrieves displayed value to scratchpad when the target supports copy
rules.engine_behavior: Implement copy from line value to scratchpad with cursor rules

rules.rule_summary: DELETE in scratchpad authorizes eligible line deletion
rules.engine_behavior: Contextual delete supported, reject ineligible deletion

rules.rule_summary: LSK invokes adjoining page and mode prompts
rules.engine_behavior: Dispatch semantic prompt action per page definition

rules.rule_summary: MENU CDU FAIL amber when self-test detects a failure
rules.engine_behavior: Self-test event controls amber FAIL, not every invalid entry

rules.rule_summary: MSG white while scratchpad displays a message
rules.engine_behavior: Derive MSG only from visible displayed message state

rules.rule_summary: OFST white while LNAV provides lateral offset guidance
rules.engine_behavior: Use an explicit LNAV-offset-guidance flag instead of mere offset request

rules.rule_summary: CALL white if non-FMC subsystem requests CDU control
rules.engine_behavior: Virtual subsystem request toggles CALL

rules.rule_summary: Brightness is a rotating display control on referenced hardware
rules.engine_behavior: In approved art it is a click-labeled DIM/BRT; mechanics mismatch must remain visible in QA

rules.rule_summary: Page keys open their related function pages
rules.engine_behavior: Route keys through semantic page registry rather than static text

rules.rule_summary: EXEC activates unexecuted modifications
rules.engine_behavior: Commit pending transaction atomically and clear modification annunciation

rules.rule_summary: EXEC white if active data has been modified but not executed
rules.engine_behavior: Only a nonempty pending transaction activates EXEC

rules.rule_summary: Alpha and numeric keys add their characters to scratchpad
rules.engine_behavior: Append on key press, not direct write to field

rules.rule_summary: Slash inserts slash character to scratchpad
rules.engine_behavior: Contextual slash validation, including data-pair rules

rules.rule_summary: Plus/minus entry initially inserts minus; successive presses alternate signs
rules.engine_behavior: Signed scratchpad state toggles - then +

rules.rule_summary: DEL inserts DELETE token
rules.engine_behavior: LSK contextual deletion behavior

rules.rule_summary: CLR clears last character or scratchpad message; hold clears all
rules.engine_behavior: Tap and long press are distinct actions

rules.rule_summary: Space key inserts a blank into scratchpad
rules.engine_behavior: Allow blanks on character entry

rules.rule_summary: Page title indicates subject and ACT/MOD status where applicable
rules.engine_behavior: Use structured page frame with title, page counter and lines

rules.rule_summary: Page has line title and separate data line, prompts, mandatory boxes and optional dashes
rules.engine_behavior: Page schema differentiates labels, entry slots, optional/required cues

rules.rule_summary: Scratchpad is a dedicated display area and must not retain previous page text
rules.engine_behavior: Full framebuffer regenerated each input; all lines cleared first

rules.rule_summary: Dual CDUs can present different pages against shared FMC data
rules.engine_behavior: Per-CDU view state and shared FMC data model; not fully wired

rules.rule_summary: FMC source switching affects which FMC supplies data
rules.engine_behavior: Stand-alone bypass virtualizes source; aircraft-mode coupling pending

rules.rule_summary: MCDU initial Menu page selects FMC with 1L
rules.engine_behavior: Menu and FMC selection in standalone renderer

rules.rule_summary: Supports 3/4/5 digit and FLxxx altitude formats with constraints and rounding
rules.engine_behavior: Validate formats and preserve format-specific normalization

rules.rule_summary: Supports three-digit calibrated speed or decimal Mach format
rules.engine_behavior: Distinct speed validator with field-specific limits

rules.rule_summary: Slash-delimited data pair requires context-specific slash rules
rules.engine_behavior: Pair parsing with field-specific presence/omission rules

rules.rule_summary: Bearing entered as three digits and 360 displays 000
rules.engine_behavior: Require 3 digits, normalize 360 to 000

rules.rule_summary: Negative entries require minus; positive may be assumed
rules.engine_behavior: Entry signed value normalization

rules.rule_summary: POS INIT contains reference airport, gate, coordinates and IRS initial position
rules.engine_behavior: Separate page schema and per-field input semantics; no physical IRS alignment

rules.rule_summary: Reference airport uses four-character ICAO input
rules.engine_behavior: Accept 4-letter ICAO; nav database resolution pending

rules.rule_summary: Route initialization exposes origin, destination and flight info
rules.engine_behavior: RTE page prototype with staging

rules.rule_summary: Departure and arrival selection refers to database procedures
rules.engine_behavior: No imaginary procedures: show data unavailable when nav database absent

rules.rule_summary: Performance initialization has performance-related inputs
rules.engine_behavior: Form entry staging; actual calculations pending

rules.rule_summary: Takeoff pages include V-speeds and performance references
rules.engine_behavior: Forms only, no certified speed calculations

rules.rule_summary: MENU selects installed CDU/FMC and optional linked subsystems
rules.engine_behavior: Virtual available FMC selection; optional systems absent

rules.rule_summary: LEGS shows route lateral and vertical leg information
rules.engine_behavior: Route leg list and edits staged; actual nav geometry not calculated

rules.rule_summary: Route modifications create MOD state requiring execution
rules.engine_behavior: Store pending changes then EXEC applies to active route

rules.rule_summary: Route discontinuities require pilot action to connect legs
rules.engine_behavior: Do not auto-connect arbitrary legs; rule engine pending

rules.rule_summary: Lateral offsets have restrictions by leg type and distance
rules.engine_behavior: Validate directional 0.0 to 99.9 NM; guidance flag separate from requested offset

rules.rule_summary: Approach reference page presents approach performance data
rules.engine_behavior: No unverified VREF computation

rules.rule_summary: Hold page configures holding fix and associated data
rules.engine_behavior: Training shell; hold path geometry pending

rules.rule_summary: Alerting outranks entry errors, which outrank advisories
rules.engine_behavior: Order priority and preserve queued messages

rules.rule_summary: Alerting message shows scratchpad, CDU MSG and panel FMC alert
rules.engine_behavior: Expose separate FMC alert output for aircraft-mode integration

rules.rule_summary: Entry error local to initiating CDU; clearing restores original scratchpad
rules.engine_behavior: Scope message to CDU, CLR restores attempted input

rules.rule_summary: Advisory messages appear on both CDUs and may be hidden by entry
rules.engine_behavior: Advisory queue with temporary entry suppression
